description: This file defines the FooTable.Query class, which is used to parse and evaluate filter queries in the FooTable library. It includes methods for constructing query objects, parsing query strings, and matching strings against queries.

classes.name: F.Query
classes.description: A class for parsing and testing filter queries, supporting logical operators, phrase matching, and negation.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Initializes a new query object with parameters for query string, whitespace treatment, phrase connector replacement, and case sensitivity.

methods.name: val
methods.description: Gets or sets the query string value; parsing it when set.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Tests if a given string matches the query conditions.

methods.name: _match
methods.description: Internal method to evaluate the parts of the query against a string.

methods.name: _left
methods.description: Evaluates the left side of the query if it exists.

methods.name: _right
methods.description: Evaluates the right side of the query if it exists.

methods.name: _parse
methods.description: Parses the query string into logical components and parts.

methods.name: _part
methods.description: Parses a single query component into an object for matching, supporting negation, phrases, and connectors.
